title: Seahawks' defense clamps down on Kenneth Walker III, hand the Chiefs their first loss of the season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks' defense clamps down on Kenneth Walker III, hand the Chiefs their first loss of the season
sources.description: The Seahawks had a spectacular defensive performance, shutting out the Chiefs in the first half and then keeping them out of the end zone in the second half on the way to a 20-3 win.
